request_notes: Form requests serialize declared object fields as JSON exactly once; String of Object fields remain serialized JSON strings. Header fields stay in headers.
Snapshot rollback and disk backup restoration are confirmed non-retryable GET mutations.
Customer context is optional and omitted from examples; the default identity is the account associated with the signing access key.

The project query fixes isHw=false because the upstream default selects joint-operation resources. Security-zone paramJson uses the separately documented numeric isHw=1; these differently typed selectors are not interchangeable.

notes: Instance/disk/snapshot details lack documented terminal enums; examples alone do not establish readiness.
The image state description explicitly applies to joint-operation resources and is not used for self-operated image waiters.
Order resource lists and bandwidth lists do not expose a unique resource identity input; no first-row waiter is created.
SNAT query has an optional identity and a singular sample but no guaranteed single-resource response when omitted; no waiter is inferred.
The project self-operated response has no captured successful example.
Flavor availability and metric/alarm states are not lifecycle completion contracts.
